purpose: Define the gameplay and economic meaning of the current finite 11-offer assort without changing the frozen runtime candidate, and lock the current post-0.1.0 Relationship slice to standing-based capacity rather than new root offers.

rules: Finite stock and a stricter personal buy limit are required on every Baseline offer.
Baseline may overlap vanilla only when the item has a clear expedition/recon/field-preparation role and the duplicate remains bounded.
Baseline must not become generic barter-material or supermarket inventory.
The authored Access quest remains the sole Admiral gate; loyalty must not add a second blocker.
Availability is finite and personally capped at one per reset.
Relationship standing must never bypass or duplicate this capability gate.
Each ammunition offer requires its own authored Munitions quest success unlock.
Quest completion is the capability gate; loyalty must not add a second blocker.
Permanent special/heavy/explosive ammunition offers are forbidden; those remain sample-only rewards.
Any new permanent ammunition offer or stock increase requires explicit rebudgeting because the current unit budget is already at 95 percent utilization.
Current Relationship progression is deliberately complete without any new root offer: standing increases requester-local finite field-marker replenishment only.
Relationship must not replace Access or Munitions capability gates.
No LL2-LL4 merchandise may be added merely to populate a tier.
A future new-offer revision requires a genuinely independent specialist availability privilege, full overlap/economy review and an explicit decision to expand beyond 11 root offers.

aggregate.economicMeaning: The frozen assort is deliberately a finite preparation/capability surface, not a general-purpose trader. Baseline establishes bounded utility; authored milestones unlock narrow capabilities; the current Relationship slice adds standing value through finite replenishment capacity on an existing consumed preparation item rather than expanding merchandise count.
